adjective-after-noun-examples.title: yon pye bwa vèt / yon bilding wo
adjective-after-noun-examples.bodyMarkdown:
Start with these adjective examples:

- **yon pye bwa vèt** — a green tree
- **yon bilding wo** — a tall building

Rather than translating word by word, notice where the describing word appears and keep the phrase in the same order.

multiword-adjective-examples.title: yon vye gran moun gason
multiword-adjective-examples.bodyMarkdown:
Here are a few more examples:

- **yon vye gran moun gason** — a very old man
- **ansyen kay wouj la** — the old red house

These examples are more complex. Keep each phrase together and notice its word order.

ki-tre-adjective-example.title: yon zanmi ki trè janti
ki-tre-adjective-example.bodyMarkdown:
Here is one more example:

- **yon zanmi ki trè janti** — a very nice friend

This phrase uses a longer pattern. Focus on recognizing it and reproducing the phrase in the same order.
